name: Imouto Kyousou
source:
Everyday is spent caring for my step sister who injured both her hands. From the bathroom to baths to meals, Yuki's attitude and behavior changes through your choices and has our main character feeling torn. Abused by the terrible selfishness of his stepsister, how long will he be able to stand his servant-like life, and how will it end?
